Figure 4:Visual text rendering under conditional vs. CFG-guided online RL.Without CFG (left), baselines overfit text accuracy by collapsing onto plain, context-free backgrounds; with CFG (right), they preserve scene context but fail to render legible text due to velocity-mismatch drift.iTDMexcels in both regimes, uniting rich scene fidelity with sharp, accurate text under CFG-guided RL.
